convention.rule: Ground datum: the lower common tangent of the near front and near rear tyre bottoms, measured on the photo (per column, scanning up from the lit asphalt to where the tyre's dark begins; pilot-emerge's method), drawn from x 1336 to x 1830 (at most one rear-rim diameter past the rear tyre).

Construction line along the nose-top plate's far long edge (corner 1 to 2): the member's own fitted straight line (max deviation of the traced points used 0.05 src px), struck 18 src px past both of its drawn ends.

Construction line along the nose-top plate's near long edge (corner 3 to the start): the member's own fitted straight line (max deviation of the traced points used 0.08 src px), struck 18 src px past both of its drawn ends. Marks curator re-fit (agent, 2026-11-22): moved 0.6 src px into the plate and started at the near edge's t 59.5 (no overshoot on the name-print side), so its ink clears the first name row.

Construction line along the rail (its last straight run): the member's own fitted straight line (max deviation of the traced points used 0.06 src px), struck 24 src px past both of its drawn ends (an end is cut back to 17.5 src px to stay 6.5 src px clear of the body lettering).
